beginner.title: Get started with StatusCake
beginner.outcome: You can: set up StatusCake, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Install and run
beginner.outcome: You can: set up StatusCake and run a first project

beginner.title: Core workflow
beginner.outcome: You can: do the everyday task StatusCake is for
beginner.practice: Build a small feature or config with StatusCake

intermediate.title: Debug and test
intermediate.outcome: You can: find and prevent problems

intermediate.title: Work in a team
intermediate.outcome: You can: use StatusCake in shared projects
intermediate.practice: Add StatusCake to a team repository with docs

intermediate.title: Signature skills in StatusCake
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make StatusCake distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced StatusCake
expert.outcome: You can: use StatusCake's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Production-ready
expert.outcome: You can: run StatusCake reliably in production
expert.practice: Add StatusCake to a CI pipeline with checks

expert.title: Integrate StatusCake into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect StatusCake with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect StatusCake to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use StatusCake well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use StatusCake" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
